hooks.command: sh -c 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ]; do hook="$d/.codex/hooks/skill_forced_eval.mjs"; marker="$d/.codex/updeng.json"; if [ -f "$hook" ] && [ -f "$marker" ]; then exec node "$hook"; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$d=(Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $hook=Join-Path $d '.codex/hooks/skill_forced_eval.mjs'; $marker=Join-Path $d '.codex/updeng.json'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker)) { & node $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $d; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $d) { exit 0 }; $d=$parent }"
